detail: 2026 first round pick, Lakers traded up one spot

sources.text: The Lakers traded up one spot for him. The speaker loves his fit next to Reaves and Luka. He probably will not do much at first, but he is a guard who hits threes, blocks shots and gets steals, with assist and scoring potential.
sources.quote: a three-point shooting, shot blocking, stealing guard who's got some assist and scoring potential. I like it.
